📺 Every Year After (2026)

Every Year After follows Percy and Sam, two childhood friends whose unforgettable summers together gradually develop into a powerful first love. Spending their vacations at a beautiful lakeside town, the two build a special connection filled with friendship, laughter, and unforgettable memories. However, as they grow older, unexpected circumstances and painful decisions threaten to separate them. Years later, Percy returns to the place where everything began, bringing back memories of the boy she never truly forgot. As old feelings resurface, both must confront their past and decide whether love deserves a second chance. Based on Carley Fortune’s bestselling novel Every Summer After, the series explores first love, heartbreak, friendship, forgiveness, and the possibility of finding your way back to someone special.

🎭 Genre: Romance • Drama • Coming-of-Age

📚 Based On: Every Summer After by Carley Fortune

🎥 Creator: Leila Gerstein

📺 Where to Watch: Prime Video in the United States. Check for current release availability.

source_details.synopsis: Every Year After is an American romantic drama television series developed by Amy B. Harris and Leila Gerstein. Based on Every Summer After by Carley Fortune, the series stars Sadie Soverall, Matt Cornett, Michael Bradway, and Abigail Cowen. The series had its world premiere at the Tribeca Festival on June 8, 2026, and was released on Amazon Prime Video on June 10, 2026. In June 2026, the series was renewed for a second season.
